name: suspect-vscode
description: Run Arazzo workflows, drive the mock gateway, and generate canonical SDKs, documentation or custom templates from OpenAPI documents.

suspect.sdk.compatibilityProfiles.description: Explicit versioned source interpretation for single-package generation. Empty preserves ordinary OpenAPI semantics. legacy-binary-string-v1 opts into string/binary markers as bytes in binary contexts. Session actions use only compatibility_profiles from their saved JSON config.

suspect.sdk.importNames.description: Explicit native import/module/namespace overrides by SDK profile, for example {"python-http":"widgets_sdk","ruby-http":"WidgetsSDK"}.

suspect.basePath.description: Path to the suspect CLI: a directory containing the `suspect` executable, the executable itself, or bare `suspect` to resolve from $PATH.

suspect.sdk.packageName.description: Initial explicit native package identity for a canonical SDK profile advertised by the selected CLI. The command prompts with the selected ecosystem's naming requirements before generation.

suspect.sdk.packageVersion.description: Initial explicit package SemVer for canonical SDK generation, independent of OpenAPI info.version. Swift requires stable SemVer without prerelease or build metadata.

suspect.sdk.operationIds.description: Exact operationId selectors for canonical SDK generation. Empty attempts every outgoing operation; unsupported operations fail rather than being dropped.

suspect.sdk.sessionConfig.description: JSON config for canonical SDK preview/watch using targets registered in the selected CLI. Absolute or relative to the selected workspace folder; empty opens a file picker. The config's spec is relative to its own directory; import_name sets a native import/module/namespace, and compatibility_profiles explicitly selects source interpretation.

suspect.sdk.sessionOutput.description: Initial output root for SDK preview/watch/drift checks. Relative paths resolve from the session config directory. Each action prompts for this directory and reads saved files.

suspect.testBaseUrl.description: Base URL prepended to operation paths when running workflow tests.

suspect.gatewayPort.description: TCP port bound by the mock gateway on 127.0.0.1.

commands.title: Suspect: Generate SDK, Docs or Custom Templates
